## Importing this folder

```bash
octail egg:import https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/ark
```

Or in the panel: Admin → Eggs → Import eggs → **GitHub** with `https://github.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/tree/main/ark`. One
egg: its raw address, `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sneakywrld/octail-eggs/main/ark/<egg>.json`.
